Definition
[Map energy (Definition K.10)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0357 1. appk:K.10\group Harmonic Maps

For $f:(\mathcal M,g)\to (\mathcal N,h)$, \[ |df|^2_{g\boxtimes h}=\operatorname {tr}_g(f^*h),\qquad E_{g,h}(f)=\int _{\mathcal M}|df|^2_{g\boxtimes h}\, d\mu _g. \]
